title.narrative: SOLID II - Promotion of Social Dialogue in the Southern Mediterranean Neighbourhood

description.narrative: The objective of SOLID II is to strengthen the consultative role of economic and social partners, including the broader civil society, in the Euro-Mediterranean region; to promote a dynamic, inclusive and reinforced institutionalised social dialogue and to promote social inclusion through social dialogue tools and organised tripartite institutions. The project will contribute to the improved social dialogue in the target countries Jordan, Morocco,Tunisia, Palestine, Algeria and Lebanon.
